'''Admiral Thrawn Mobquet A-1 Deluxe''' is a strategy article published on [[The Outer Rim (fan site)|The Outer Rim]] under the handle Admiral Thrawn, titled ''Mobquet A-1 Deluxe...Not Just A Two Man Carrier!!''.<ref name="or">[https://www.geocities.ws/ev9d11/TheOuterRim/Articles/Mobquet.htm Mobquet A-1 Deluxe...Not Just A Two Man Carrier!!], The Outer Rim (Admiral Thrawn). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261030142553/https://www.geocities.ws/ev9d11/TheOuterRim/Articles/Mobquet.htm Internet Archive]</ref>

== Article ==

<blockquote>
<div style="white-space:pre-wrap; font-family:inherit"><nowiki>
Title: Mobquet A-1 Deluxe...Not
Just A Two Man Carrier!!


Mobquet A-1 Deluxe...Whats that???
Well it's a great bounty hunters dream car. So what's so cool about this vehicle
other than the fact it has a destiny of 4? Is that it deploys for only 2, has
a forfeit of 5 and it is very non-unique, has a power of 2...oooops did I say
2, Well really that's not so bad when you can load up on a react and then unload
after the react, lost the battle or won it but had to forfiet, loose the Mobquet
forfiet 5. Now with a manuver of 5 it will be quite had to hit,unless the opponent
has a lightsaber, but really, who's going to target that? Now we have deserts,
and the Sarlacc pit, vehicles are a must now!! 3 landspeed is awsome now!! The
game text says that it can only carry 2 passengers. Not so bad though, it "Moves
free if Jabba or any bounty hunter aboard." With the Jabba's palace set now
containg a few more bounty hunters, moving free is as easy as 1,2,3. It can
also react for free to a battle where you have a bounty hunter (or smuggler,
or thief). Antipersonnel laser cannons can be deployed on them, add Jabba and
the good Doctor. You have a lean mean killing machine that can react!!!


Admiral
Thrawn
</nowiki></div>
</blockquote>
